title: Mujrayi qahate aab bhi tha aur ghiza na thi
body:
Mujrayi qahate aab bhi tha aur ghiza na thi
par behawaas jung me fouje quda na thi
<<DIVIDER>>
mujrayi kya ghazab hai kisi ko haya na thi
balwe me ahlebait me sar par rida na thi
<<DIVIDER>>
lekar ridae'n naariyo ne ghar jala diya
bewo ke waaste kahi'n chupne ko jaa'n na thi
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhi zaba'n dikhaane pe zaalim ne maara tha
banu ke sheerqaar ki ya rab qata na thi
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab se boli fatima kuch yaad to karo
kis dukh me kis jagah mai shareeke buka na thi
<<DIVIDER>>
chod aayi mere bache ko jungle me be kafan
qaabil kafan ke lash musaafir ke kya na thi
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne arz ki ke mai dafnaati kis tarah
amma khuda gawah ke sar par rida na thi
